product.name: OMTANKSAM chair
product.note: Parts only: screws and fittings aren’t shown, and sizes are approximate. Each step names the page of your paper manual to follow.

steps.title: Start with 3 pieces and 2 legs
steps.instruction: Join 3 pieces and 2 legs (A, B, C, D, E), as the animation shows. Page 5 of the IKEA manual shows this step.

faq.answer: This guide doesn’t show fittings for the OMTANKSAM chair. Page 5 of the paper manual shows which ones to use and how many.
The blue parts: A (piece, about 56 cm), B (leg, about 42 cm), C (piece, about 42 cm), D (piece, about 42 cm), E (leg, about 42 cm). Watch where they go in the animation.
Sizes are approximate: this model has no real measurements, so it is shown about 82 cm tall.
